g.text: The upper summand retains cohomology. The lower cokernel measures Frobenius linearization on that retained object.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183047

g.text: Proofs: Homotopy defect, projector and deformation retract; Frobenius cross-effect, F1–F17. No cohomology equivalence is assumed.
